subject: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>, ClearBank NetOps <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:18:00Z
Subject: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps

Hi Samir / NetOps team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can put a short mutual action plan together: 

- Desired hosting mode: Private VPC (ClearBank indicated preference during call). Please confirm if this is final or if you want Redwood Dedicated first as a stop-gap.
- Connectivity model: you mentioned PrivateLink as the preferred approach. Confirm: PrivateLink (AWS interface endpoint) vs VPC Peering? If PrivateLink, we need the account ID and desired endpoint subnet(s).
- Egress / allowlist: please provide the external-facing IP(s) or CIDR(s) you will allow for outbound traffic from Redwood (we will provide our egress IP block once we know staging vs prod).
- Tenant mapping: single tenancy (one customer VPC) or multiple ClearBank tenants per VPC? Any tenancy decisions will affect routing and firewall rules.
- Timeline: you mentioned "end of January" for go-live. Confirm target date and any blackout windows.

Attachments: we promised a short checklist — attaching the Redwood PrivateLink checklist and linking our readiness doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/private-vpc-checklist

Next steps I propose: 
1) You send network diagram + target CIDRs (attachment stub accepted)
2) We share the egress IPs for staging and prod and a short runbook for endpoint validation
3) 30-minute technical alignment (NetOps + Redwood infra) — propose Dec 20 or Jan 4 (timezones: CET).

If you can reply with the three bullets above (connectivity model, CIDR/IPs, timeline), we’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

----
Attachment: redwood-privatelink-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

-----Original Message-----

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, ClearBank NetOps <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps

Thanks Jonas — good summary. A few answers inline: 

- Hosting mode: Private VPC is the goal. We evaluated Dedicated but prefer PrivateLink for isolation.
- Connectivity: PrivateLink preferred (we run in AWS). I can share the AWS account ID and the subnet ranges we’d like endpoints in.
- Egress: NetOps will allow a small set of outbound IPs from Redwood into our services; we don’t control Redwood egress but will provide the allowlist entries once you provide the Redwood IPs.
- Tenant mapping: Single tenancy for now (one ClearBank VPC, multiple services behind it).
- Timeline: Targeting mid-to-late January for production; staging earlier in January.

I’m attaching our network diagram (sanitized). Please confirm if the diagram gives you what you need.

Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Network Engineer, ClearBank
samir.patel@clearbank.com

----
Attachment: clearbank-network-diagram.png (image/png)

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>, ClearBank NetOps <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps

Thanks Samir — diagram is helpful. A couple of operational clarifications from Redwood side: 

1) Ownership of endpoint setup: Redwood will provision and manage the endpoint on our side. ClearBank NetOps will need to create any acceptance rules and ensure the endpoint subnet has route access.
2) DNS and TLS: Will ClearBank manage DNS entries for the interface endpoint? We can provide TLS certs if you prefer us to handle termination.
3) Staging vs Prod: propose we create a staging PrivateLink endpoint (isolated subnet) first, validate flows, then promote to production. Staging target: week of Jan 4. Production target: week of Jan 18-22 (flexible).
4) Egress allowlist: Samir, can you confirm who on NetOps will own the firewall rule changes? We’ll share our public egress IPs once we finalize the staging/prod split.

Proposed immediate actions we’ll prepare on our side: 
- Runbook for endpoint validation (tests, expected status codes, example calls)
- IP egress list (staging + prod)
- Short playbook for rollback if connectivity fails during cutover

I’ll draft a 1-page mutual action plan after we confirm dates — Jonas / Neha, want to sync on the runbook before I send?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>, ClearBank NetOps <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T11:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps

Samir — forwarding a couple of internal notes below. To be explicit: Redwood will stand up the PrivateLink endpoint on the Redwood side and provide the endpoint DNS name and egress IPs for your allowlist. We ask ClearBank NetOps to confirm: 

- Which specific CIDR(s) you will allow for outgoing traffic from Redwood (we will provide ours too)
- Primary NetOps contact for firewall changes and a preferred maintenance window (if any)
- Whether you want TLS termination on your side or Redwood to terminate and present certs

Attaching the checklist again. If you can reply with the CIDR(s) and a NetOps contact we’ll schedule the technical alignment call.

Thanks,
Jonas

----
Attachment: redwood-privatelink-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>, ClearBank NetOps <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment provisioning & IP allowlist — next steps

Hi Samir — quick note from security/compliance: 

- SOC2 evidence: we can provide the relevant SOC2 artifacts and a short questionnaire for your audit team. Let us know who to send the secure share to.
- Data residency and retention: confirm if any additional retention windows apply beyond our default (we will document in the SOW).
- Pre-provisioning call: Neha here — I can run the security checklist during the technical alignment call. Proposed slots: Dec 20 10:00 CET or Jan 4 14:00 CET. Which works for you?

If those dates work, Jonas / Marissa, please confirm and we’ll lock the meeting and share an agenda (endpoint tests, allowlist validation, TLS plan, rollback criteria).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
